scenario: A machine-readable paper business validation report treats synthetic/offline candidate evidence as authorization for live WriteLab or real-content execution.
input_report_features: business_validation_report.json sets validation_mode='synthetic_offline', business_validation_pass=true, candidate_status='ready', and live_execution_authorized=true. It claims the offline candidate unlocks live_writelab execution or real_content_pilot behavior without a separate fresh RuntimeAuthorization record and human_gate_ref.
expected_findings: synthetic_offline validation cannot authorize live WriteLab or real-content execution
business_validation_pass remains candidate verification evidence only
live_execution_authorized must remain false or absent without separate fresh RuntimeAuthorization
Live WriteLab or real-content escalation requires a human_gate_ref boundary record
